The create paths are unaffected (app/product/[id].tsx:389 only calls createSubscription when !isInstant; SubscribeSheet.tsx:102 coerces one_time/custom to daily), so G1 is not at risk, but the option should be hidden in backend mode or mapped to a cancel.

Behaviour change: addVacation with no live plan now throws 'Start a subscription first' (lib/subscriptions.ts:500). Before, a standing vacation could be recorded ahead of the first plan and rode along at birth (old sub-create body). Vacations are now ranges on server rows only, so this is a consequence of the rule the owner should confirm.

Offline before any read this session, listAddresses returns only the outbox (lib/api.ts:301-308): AddressPicker/checkout show no saved address, the sweep skips, and the subscribe gate opens the map even for a member with a saved pin (unless the user_location 'exact' row is set). A pin dropped in that state creates a NEW address that, on replay, duplicates the one the server already had. Previously the persisted local copy answered offline. Consequence of 'never a display source'; not a guard break.

Lost-invalidation race: fetchAddresses (lib/api.ts:265-275) and fetchSubscriptions (lib/subscriptions.ts:158-170) assign the cache AFTER the await; an invalidateAddressCache()/invalidateSubscriptionCache() that fires while that GET is in flight (e.g. the boot hydrateAddressCache racing an addAddress) is overwritten by the stale result. Subscriptions self-heal via listSubscriptions({refresh:true}) on home focus; addresses have no refresh reader, so a just-added address can be missing from the picker until the next mutation. G4 still holds because AddressCapture also sets the user_location 'exact' row.

lib/complaints.ts:177 keeps a permanently rejected complaint (4xx on POST /complaints) queued and retried on every refresh forever, shown as 'queued'; every other outbox in this series drops on a permanent rejection. Pre-existing pattern retained by 2eb65bc.
left_undone: G3 cancel remains best-effort (walletApi.ts:729, profileApi.ts:82): a failed mandate CANCEL still lets /me/erasure proceed. The spec required only the READ to stop deletion, so it conforms; B1 flagged it for an owner ruling.

In-memory caches are not cleared on signOut: addressCache (lib/api.ts:168), subsCache (lib/subscriptions.ts:130), lastServerTrial (lib/trial.ts:202), deliveryPrefs `cached` (lib/deliveryPrefs.ts:31). All are keyed by uid so no cross-account read is possible, but the previous member's rows stay in process memory until exit, and a same-account sign-out/sign-in within one process serves the pre-sign-out address copy (hydrateAddressCache early-returns on uid match, api.ts:283) until a mutation.

Derived-cache flags were not addressed and are not in the owner's decided list: lib/walletGate.ts `pyaas_wallet_unlocked:<uid>`, lib/freePack.ts `pyaas_free_pack_qualified:<uid>`, and the lowbal auto-paused id set (lib/subscriptions.ts:583). None is a display source for a server row, but each persists a domain fact locally.

Not decided by the owner and left as device-local with no endpoint: the local notifications feed (lib/notificationCenter.ts), favorites (store/favorites.ts), the legacy 'vip' row (lib/vip.ts:80-85 still reads it in backend mode), and quality_tests (lib/quality.ts).

getDeliveryPrefs offline before any read this session returns DEFAULT_PREFS (lib/deliveryPrefs.ts:70-73); saveDeliveryPrefs merges the edit onto that baseline into the outbox (:90-104), whose replay PATCHes all three fields (toWire :36), so an offline first-session edit of one switch can reset the other two server-side on replay.

Request paths: every path the app calls exists in module.go on integration/delivery (auth/otp/*, /auth/logout, /me, /me/erasure, /users/me/consents, /wallet*, /mandate/*, /subscriptions[/{id}[/pause|resume|cancel]], /trial/me, /addresses[/{id}[/default]], /orders[/{id}[/cancel|review]], /complaints, /push/register, /uploads/presign, /crm/*, /catalog, /serviceability, /waitlist, /partner-leads, /wishlist/leads, /traceability/{code}). The only non-existent paths are inside comments and pre-date 59ee930: lib/invoice.ts:23 `/orders/{id}/invoice` (TODO) and lib/quality.ts:88 `/quality/tests` (commented-out TODO). PATCH /addresses/{id} exists server-side but is no longer called (addr-coords replay removed). Wire field names checked against the backend: PATCH /me delivery_prefs sends `notes` and reads back `note` (models.go sanitizeDeliveryPrefs reads 'notes'/'instructions'/'note'); POST /addresses and POST /subscriptions carry the same keys the old mirror handlers sent; profile uses `full_name` (models.go:35).
MIRRORED_FREQUENCIES (lib/subscriptions.ts:302) is now referenced only by the legacy read-only 'sub-edit' handler (:364); harmless, tsc clean.
